full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiff is that the suit land measuring 0.49 acre in plot No. 727, Khatian No. 385 of mouza Ramnagar District Comilla belonged to defendant No. 1 Sukumar Dey who proposed to sell the land to the petitioner and the petitioner agreed to purchase the same at Taka 4,900.00 and on receipt of Taka 4,460.00 the opposite party No. 1 executed a bainapatra in favour of the petitioner and promised to give a registered sale deed on payment of balance amount within 30th Chaitra, 1382 BS. The defendant No. 1 delivered possession of the suit land to the petitioner and he has been in possession. Defendant No. 1 was approached and balance amount of consideration was offered but the defendant No. 1 did not grant the promised sale deed and hence this suit.
